input.fixture_ref: frozen row: Closure without return annotation

applicability.reason: Requires the closure return annotation to survive parsing, plus expected-callable-type tracking. Measured two blockers. First, the parser READS the annotation and discards it: crates/iris-parser/src/lib.rs parses `-> Type` inside a closure header but builds `Expression::Closure { parameters, body }` with no return field, so an annotated and a bare closure are the SAME AST node and `{ |x: Integer| -> Integer; x }` cannot be told from `{ |x| x }`. Second, C017 diagnoses only where NO unique expected callable type exists, and the analyser tracks no expected type at all. Diagnosing every unannotated closure instead would fire on 87 of them in currently passing vectors, 65 of those trailing blocks whose expected type comes from the callee's `&block` parameter.
